forms.ex: Was machst du am Wochenende?
forms.exEn: What are you doing at the weekend?

forms.en: open (a door, a window, a parcel); open up (a shop)
forms.why: auf = open: you make it open.
forms.ex: Kannst du bitte die Tür aufmachen?
forms.exEn: Can you open the door, please?

forms.en: presentation, get-up, look (of a product, a person)
forms.why: How something is 'made up' to be shown: its outward look.
forms.ex: Das Buch hat eine sehr schöne Aufmachung.
forms.exEn: The book is very nicely presented.

forms.en: close, shut (a window, a shop)
forms.why: zu = shut: you make it shut.
forms.ex: Kannst du bitte das Fenster zumachen?
forms.exEn: Can you close the window, please?

forms.en: switch on, turn on (colloquial); dress (a salad); chat up
forms.clue: to switch on (the light, the TV)
forms.why: an = on: you make it be on.
forms.ex: Mach bitte das Licht an.
forms.exEn: Please switch the light on.

forms.en: switch off, turn off; arrange (a time); matter (es macht mir nichts aus)
forms.clue: to switch off (the light, the TV)
forms.why: aus = off, out: you make it be off; you settle a time.
forms.ex: Kannst du bitte den Fernseher ausmachen?
forms.exEn: Can you turn off the TV, please?

forms.en: agree (on), settle (a deal); take off, remove (a label)
forms.clue: to agree on (a deal); to take off
forms.why: ab = off, settled: you take a thing off; you settle a deal.
forms.ex: Wir haben abgemacht, dass jeder zehn Euro zahlt.
forms.exEn: We agreed that everyone pays ten euros.

forms.en: agreement, deal
forms.ex: Wir müssen uns an die Abmachung halten.
forms.exEn: We have to stick to the agreement.

forms.en: join in, take part; go through (hard times)
forms.clue: to join in, to take part
forms.why: mit = with: you do it with the others.
forms.ex: Machst du beim Sportfest auch mit?
forms.exEn: Are you taking part in the sports day too?

forms.en: copy, imitate; fake
forms.why: nach = after: you do it after someone, the same way.
forms.ex: Die Kinder machen alles nach, was ich tue.
forms.exEn: The children copy everything I do.

forms.en: show (how to do); fool, kid (someone)
forms.why: vor = before, in front: you do it in front of someone, or put on a show for them.
forms.ex: Mach dir doch nichts vor!
forms.exEn: Don't kid yourself!

forms.en: fasten, tie up (a boat); fix, agree (a date)
forms.clue: to fasten, to tie up (a boat)
forms.why: fest = firm, fixed: you make it fixed.
forms.ex: Wir haben das Boot am Steg festgemacht.
forms.exEn: We tied the boat up at the jetty.

forms.en: carry on, continue
forms.why: weiter = on, further: you go on doing it.
forms.ex: Nach der Pause machen wir weiter.
forms.exEn: We'll carry on after the break.

forms.en: remove, get rid of (a stain; colloquial)
forms.why: weg = away: you make it go away.
forms.ex: Wie kann ich diesen Fleck wegmachen?
forms.exEn: How can I get this stain out?

forms.en: go through (hard times); party all night (colloquial)
forms.why: durch = through: you live through something to the end.
forms.ex: Sie hat in letzter Zeit viel durchgemacht.
forms.exEn: She has been through a lot lately.

forms.en: leave, bequeath (in a will)
forms.why: ver = away: you make something pass away from you to another person.
forms.ex: Die Großmutter hat ihm ihr Haus vermacht.
forms.exEn: His grandmother left him her house.

forms.en: sich zurechtmachen: get ready, do yourself up; prepare (something)
forms.clue: to get ready, to do yourself up (sich)
forms.why: zurecht = right, in order: you make yourself look right.
forms.ex: Sie macht sich noch schnell zurecht.
forms.exEn: She's just quickly getting ready.

forms.en: feasible, doable
forms.ex: Das Projekt ist bis Freitag machbar.
forms.exEn: The project can be done by Friday.

forms.en: feasibility
forms.ex: Wir prüfen zuerst die Machbarkeit des Projekts.
forms.exEn: First we're checking whether the project is feasible.

forms.en: doer, person of action; maker (of a film, a product)
forms.clue: the doer (someone who gets things done)
forms.ex: Unser neuer Chef ist ein echter Macher.
forms.exEn: Our new boss is a real doer.

forms.en: skip work or school (colloquial)
forms.why: Learn it as a word: blau (blue) does not explain it.
forms.note: Splits like a separable verb: Ich mache heute blau.
forms.ex: Er macht heute einfach blau.
forms.exEn: He's just skipping work today.
